blocks.text: Police equipped with riot shields and batons immediately blocked the road in front of Liwasang Bonifacio in anticipation of their planned march to PICC. Photo by Zacarian Sarao MANILA, Philippines — The Manila Police District (MPD) on Tuesday warned protesters not to breach the boundaries of Liwasang Bonifacio, stating that they will arrest rallyists should they proceed with their march. The MPD said this amid an ongoing demonstration by various groups at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila where they are protesting the arrival of United States President Donald Trump for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, as well as the […]...
